note: AEGIS Global Intelligence source registry: the outlets analysts monitor when collecting and drafting records. Being listed is not an endorsement and does not make a source independent corroboration. Each record still cites the specific article it relies on, and syndicated copies still count once. role 'reporting' may support confirmed facts and reported claims. Role 'perspective' (commentary or opinion) may only be cited in international_perspectives, and build_global.py enforces that through the 'match' URL prefixes. feed_verified=false means the feed address has not yet been checked by fetching it.

sources.name: BBC News — World
sources.notes: UK public broadcaster, editorially independent of government.

sources.name: Al Jazeera English — News
sources.notes: Funded by the State of Qatar. Set state_affiliated on record sources that cite it, and corroborate Gulf-politics claims independently.

sources.name: Al Jazeera English — Opinion
sources.notes: Commentary. Cite only in international_perspectives, attributed to the named author.

sources.name: Double Down News
sources.notes: UK independent video outlet publishing first-person commentary. Cite only in international_perspectives, attributed to the speaker. The homepage address has not been checked by fetching it.

sources.name: Eagle News
sources.notes: Philippine news network. Its international stories are often wire copy, so set syndicated_from (e.g. AFP) when they are.

sources.name: Caribbean Media Corporation (CMC)
sources.notes: Regional Caribbean news agency. Its stories are widely republished (e.g. by the Jamaica Gleaner), so set syndicated_from 'CMC' on copies. The site uses region 'Latin America' for the Caribbean.

sources.name: Caribbean360
sources.notes: Caribbean regional news site. Check whether a story is CMC copy and set syndicated_from if so.

sources.name: CoinDesk
sources.notes: Cryptocurrency markets and policy. Relevant to exchange hacks, sanctions evasion and illicit-finance records.

sources.name: Reuters — World
sources.notes: Wire service. Many outlets republish it, so set syndicated_from 'Reuters' on copies, which count once.

sources.name: AP News — World
sources.notes: Wire service. Set syndicated_from 'AP' on republished copies.

sources.name: France 24 — International
sources.notes: French public international broadcaster (France Medias Monde).
